SANnav - Renewal License (no max)
 Select one of these SANnav licenses only if this is a renewal of a current SANnav licenses otherwise order a net new license from the SANnav - New License section.
Note changes to the trial license availability:
- 90-day trial license available with all SANnav releases through v2.2.0
- 30-day trial license available with SANnav v2.2.1 and v2.2.2
- No trial license available with upcoming SANnav v2.3.0
Only one SANnav renewal licenses can be ordered per HPE order even if the customer has multiple renewals.
Mandatory: The following information is required to order a SANnav renewal license:
1) End Customer Name (entity that will own/utilize the licenses)
2) End Customer Email (entity that will own/utilize the licenses)
3) End Customer SANnav Serial Number(s)
4) Sales Representative Email
5) Reseller Name and Email (if applicable)
6) Distributor Name and Email (if applicable)
7) A SRV Code Request must be made in the HPE SRV Code Request SharePoint at the following link:
https://hpe.sharepoint.com/teams/srvcode/Lists/SANnav Renewal Verification Code Requests/AllItems.aspx
8) After an HPE sales order has been created the HPE Order Number must be updated in the SharePoint, an email will be systematically sent to the
Sales Representative requesting the order number.
Once the order has been placed and the above has been completed the following will occurr:
a) The end customer will receive a notification the license will be available in 2-3 days
b) The end customer will then activate the entitlement and retrieve the license key at My HPE Software Center at:
https://myenterpriselicense.hpe.com/cwp-ui/auth/login
c) The end customer installs the license
